mapper.select: SELECT n.notice_id AS noticeId, n.admin_id AS adminId, n.title AS title, n.content AS content, n.is_active AS isActive, n.view_count AS viewCount, n.created_date AS createdDate, n.updated_date AS updatedDate FROM NOTICE n ORDER BY n.notice_id DESC

SELECT n.notice_id AS noticeId, n.admin_id AS adminId, n.title AS title, n.content AS content, n.is_active AS isActive, n.view_count AS viewCount, n.created_date AS createdDate, n.updated_date AS updatedDate FROM NOTICE n WHERE n.notice_id = #{noticeId}

SELECT i.image_id AS imageId, i.notice_id AS noticeId, i.image_url AS imageUrl, i.sort_order AS sortOrder, i.created_date AS createdDate FROM NOTICE_IMAGE i WHERE i.notice_id = #{noticeId} ORDER BY i.sort_order ASC, i.image_id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO NOTICE ( notice_id, admin_id, title, content, is_active, view_count, created_date, updated_date ) VALUES ( #{noticeId}, #{adminId}, #{title}, #{content}, NVL(#{isActive}, 'Y'), NVL(#{viewCount}, 0), SYSDATE, SYSDATE )
mapper.update: UPDATE NOTICE SET title = #{title}, content = #{content}, is_active = NVL(#{isActive}, 'Y'), updated_date = SYSDATE WHERE notice_id = #{noticeId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO NOTICE_IMAGE ( image_id, notice_id, image_url, sort_order, created_date ) VALUES ( #{imageId}, #{noticeId}, #{imageUrl}, #{sortOrder}, SYSDATE )
